structured.answer: I understood that I can take the money out with no tax after 6 years, or after 3 years since I'm past retirement age. The calculator showed about 66,000 ₪ "נשאר בידיים" after 5 years with tax taken off, plus a red minus, and it never asked my age, so I'll ask my son or the employer before I believe any amount.

stuck.why: It shows a red '−13,974' and says 29,768 ₪ goes to income tax at 5 years. It doesn't say whether that applies to someone over retirement age, who the text says only needs 3 years.
The amounts 15,712 ₪ and 20,566 ₪ appear with their sentence cut off, so I didn't know what they limit.
I don't know what this track is, and it sounded like shares.

findings.what: A red minus and striped red tax block, plus 'almost 30,000 to tax', shows up before any reassurance. It scares you away.
There is no age input, so the 3-year rule for retirees doesn't seem to be used. The default 5 years shows tax that might not apply to me.
Too many numbers in one paragraph (50,719, 29,768, 15,794, 66,601, 66,280), and I can't tell which is the answer.
Black background with grey text is hard to read even enlarged. The subtitle and labels are pale.
findings.where: All screens, especially the subtitle on screen 1 and labels on screen 4

findings.what: English letters and jargon (S&P500, מסלול מדד) are given as the example track.
The bar colours (yellow, teal, grey, dark olive) are hard to tell apart, and there's no sentence saying what the chart means.
Amounts at the top of screen 2 have no visible context.
Codes like KH-19 and PF-18 mean nothing to an ordinary reader.
